description: Curated real RK3588 showcase snapshot; selected for visual demonstration, not a full benchmark.
caveats: This is a curated selection of real RK3588 pipeline frames, not a complete benchmark.
BBox overlay is proposal-level (FastSAM/VLM), not verified ground-truth localization.
Localization reliability varies by category and defect type.
Success frames demonstrate clear visual cases; limitation frames are included for transparency.
See docs/experiments/phase9_ead_localization_reliability.md for board-side localization reliability analysis.
